headline: A draft with a blank in square brackets, in its body or its subject, no longer passes the voice check, and an off-limits person's last name on its own is now held. Each meeting's write-up is tied to its own calendar event, and live Today can mark a single meeting gone from your calendar. Maintenance says why a step was refused and no longer lists the session sweep as skipped on every cloud run. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
